ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the effectiveness of the state's prevention measures
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are the state's prevention measures?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for improved oversight and prevention measures. By analyzing data and public records, we can shed light on the scope of the issue and identify areas for improvement.
